content: ली I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (लयति) To melt, dissolve. --II. €9 <ab>P.</ab> (लिनाति) .²1 To adhere. .²2 To melt, usually with वि. --III. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (लीयते, लीन) .²1 To stick or adhere firmly to, cling to. .²2 To clasp, embrace. .²3 To lie or rest on, recline, stay or dwell in, lurk, hide, cower down; (भृङ्गाङ्गनाः) लीयन्ते मुकुलान्तरेषु शनकैः संजातलज्जा इव <ls>Ratn. 1. 26</ls>; हरिशिशुरुत्पतितुं द्रागङ्गान्याकुञ्च्य लीयते निमृतम् <ls>Bv. 1. 106</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 9</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6. 16</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 12</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">7. 21</ls>; <ls>Bk. 18. 13</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 26</ls>. .²4 To be dissolved, melt away. .²5 To be sticky or viscous. .²6 To be absorbed in, be devoted or attached to; माधव मनसिजविशिखभयादिव भावनया त्वयि लीना <ls>Gīt. 4</ls>. .²7 To vanish, disappear. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (लापयति-ते, लाययति-ते, लीनयति-ते|लालयति-ते) To melt, dissolve, liquefy. (The form लापयते is used in the sense of ‘to honour’, ‘cause to be honoured’; जटाभिर्लापयते = पूजामधिगच्छति; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>P. I. 3. 70.</ls>).
